Swipe · captured 2026-08-11 · F132

Justin Moore — Creator Wizard / Sponsor Magnet

The opposite of every funnel in this file. No paid traffic, no webinar, no VSL, no countdown theatre, no closer on the phone at the top. A 27,000 person newsletter that delivers actual sponsorship opportunities twice a week feeds a $27 four-day live challenge, which feeds a $12,000 coaching program sold by a two-branch application that gates on revenue already earned. The single biggest structural move: he KILLED his $3,000 course and turned it into a free bonus inside the coaching, leaving the full sales page live as a value stack. Positioning is one line, in the nav on every page — 0% cut, we're coaches not managers — which names a talent manager, not another course, as the competitor.

PROOF LAYER

Named people with jobs, not income screenshots

Every proof point is a full name attached to a public identity you can verify yourself. No blurred Stripe dashboards, no anonymous wins. Ali Abdaal alone does more work than 50 testimonial screenshots because the audience already trusts him.
Ali Abdaal£200,000, ~2x sponsorship revenue
Jenny Hoyos$15,000 — full case study page
Jenny Wood$6,000 first deal, one email
Molly Donlan$17,000 from newsletter opportunities
Justin himself$5M+ personal since 2009
Students506 'happy creators'
Screenshotszero
Branch A — you already close deals

'Have you negotiated a sponsorship in the last 30 days?' → then sponsorships closed in 12mo (0-2 / 3-10 / 11-19 / 20+), sponsorship revenue and TOTAL revenue in 6 bands from $0 to $200k+, largest deal ever, inbound inquiries per month, audience size, and job situation (full-time creator / creator + part-time / creator + full-time job). He is measuring existing cashflow, not ambition.

VERIFIED · read from the live Paperform config, ztbjvcrc
Branch B — you don't, and the questions change

If you have NOT negotiated recently he swaps in 'Have you closed any brand deals in the past?' and adds the question branch A never gets: 'Have you invested money into growing your business in the last 12 months? (coaching, courses, etc.)' If you can't show revenue, he checks whether you have ever paid for help before.

VERIFIED · both branches present in the same form config
The price gate is a commitment question, not a disclosure

'If we could help you achieve your sponsorship goals and be in your corner with your pitches, pricing, negotiations, packages, and proposals, would it be well worth the $12k investment to work with us?' — Yes / No / Maybe. Followed immediately by 'how soon would you want to get started? ASAP / 1-2 months / 3+ months / I'm not interested in coaching at all.' Price objection and timeline objection are both dead before the call is booked.

VERIFIED · questions 11 and 12 of the live application
The $27 ticket is a buyer filter, not a revenue line

At $27 against $590 of stacked bonuses the challenge cannot be about margin. It does three things a free webinar can't: it takes a card, it takes a phone number plus SMS autodialer consent, and it makes the refund conditional on attending all four days with camera on. He is buying a list of people who have paid him once and can be legally called.

READ · inferred from checkout fields + refund terms, not stated by him
The lead magnet is a recurring deliverable, not a PDF

'Get brand sponsorship opportunities in your inbox every Monday and Thursday.' The subscriber has a reason to open twice a week forever, and the testimonial on the opt-in page is 'I have made over $17,000 from brand deals I found through Justin's newsletter' — the free thing has a dollar figure attached to it.

VERIFIED · captured on pages.creatorwizard.com/join
'0% Cut Policy' is the whole positioning, in the nav

'We're coaches, not managers. You keep 100% of your sponsorship revenue.' It sits in the top nav, the footer of every page, and has its own anchor on the About page. His competitor is not another course — it's a talent manager taking 20%. Naming the enemy in the nav means every page is arguing against the same alternative.

VERIFIED · present on all 15 captured pages
What happens between the $27 buy and the $12k application

Not captured. The challenge does not start until Aug 17, the checkout requires a card and a phone number, and under the swipe hard rules we never submitted either. No post-purchase emails, no upsell path, no order bump, and no evidence of how Day 4 pitches into the application.

UNVERIFIED · would require a real card and a real phone number
Whether the coaching price is really $12k for everyone

The application says $12k. The affiliates page says '5 figures'. A 2024 third-party write-up described $297/mo group and $1k/mo private tiers. Those are almost certainly a retired structure, but we have not seen a current price page — there isn't one.

PARTIALLY VERIFIED · $12k is first-party and current; tiers are not
